requirements.text: Customers can book appointments online, selecting their preferred barber, service, and available time slots.
Automated reminders will be sent via SMS and email 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments, including options to confirm or reschedule.
Barbers can manage their schedules by setting their availability, blocking off times, and seeing real-time updates on appointments.
The system must comply with data protection laws and include a cancellation policy with a grace period for first-time customers.
The solution needs to be cost-effective to fit the budget of a small independent shop.
Booking interface must be usable on mobile devices.
Barbers should be able to set their own working hours and update them easily.
System must show barber availability in real time to prevent double bookings.
Barbers need a clear view of their appointments for the day or week ahead.
